MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The external hard drive felt useful because backing up files would support the computer and Raspberry Pi equipment I already use.",
    "The HDMI and Ethernet cables fit my interest in practical connections and a tidy workspace, even though I do not need more of them right now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV devices and Echo Dot introduce streaming or voice-assistant uses that my recent purchases do not show a need for.",
    "The Fire-specific memory card does not match any device I have shown interest in supporting; using microSD cards does not mean I own a Fire device.",
    "The desktop power supply and tablet assume new projects or devices, while my recent activity centers on maintaining and connecting existing equipment."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been treated as interest in streaming devices, tablets, and smart speakers generally.",
    "My HDMI cable and Raspberry Pi purchases seem to have been taken as reasons to suggest several TV streamers, although those purchases do not establish that need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Ethernet cable pack makes another pack less useful now, even though it matches the kind of accessory I buy.",
    "The networking adapter, headphone mount, cable-management supplies, and duster point toward improving an existing setup rather than adding entertainment devices.",
    "Compatibility and a distinct practical purpose matter: a backup drive offers a new use, while another cable needs a clear reason to replace or supplement what I have."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in computer accessories but stretched it into entertainment devices and missed the difference between a useful addition and something I recently bought."
}
